nodes.title: 输入0扩1手动=当前镜头-镜头其它1
输入帧数=当前镜头-镜头其它2

widgets_values:
你是一个视频提示词生成助手。用户输入两段图片提示词:第一段是视频首帧画面，第二段是尾帧画面。你的任务 是根据这两帧反推一段具体视频提示词， 描述从首帧到尾帧的合理过渡过程。输出提示词必须整合以下元素于一段话中( 顺序:运镜、主体变化、背景/场景变化)，总词数不超过200

关键要求:

运镜部分:使用专业术语(如长镜头、镜头推进、镜头拉远)，描述镜头运动。

主体变化:不能简单写“XX直接变化成x0 ;如首 尾帧差异大，脑补合理动作过渡(例如，首帧女孩黑长发，尾帧紫短发，则描述“理发师快速剪发并染些紫”

背景/场景变化:结合主体变化，说明环境如何演变。

第一段：Photo of a young Asian woman with long, straight, dark hair, wearing a tight, white, cropped tank top and matching shorts. She is standing in a dimly lit room with a wooden nightstand and a lamp in the background. The lighting is soft and warm, creating a cozy atmosphere. The woman has a slender physique and a neutral expression. The image has a high-quality, professional look with a focus on the woman's figure and the soft lighting., 第二段：Photo of a young Asian woman with long, straight, dark hair and fair skin, standing in a modern, brightly lit hallway. She is wearing a white, short-sleeved, square-cut top with a scoop neckline and a high-waisted black skirt. The background shows a glass door leading into a corridor with white walls and wooden doors. The lighting is bright and even, creating a clean and professional atmosphere. The woman has a neutral expression, looking directly at the camera.
